runs.text: This document follows OPC 20020 - UA Companion Specification Template version 1.01.19. The template admits no deviation. The departures below are stated here because the subject matter of this document cannot satisfy the clause concerned; every other requirement of the template is met.

This document defines a JSON-LD vocabulary and a mapping between OPC UA NodeSet2 files and W3C Web of Things documents. It defines no OPC UA information model of its own: it has no NodeSet, no ObjectTypes, no VariableTypes, no DataTypes, no ReferenceTypes and no Instances. The NodeClass clauses of OPC 20020 are therefore omitted rather than left empty, and Annex A states the machine-readable artifacts this document does define — the JSON-LD context and the JSON Schema — in place of a NodeSet.

general.title: General information to WoT binding and OPC UA
Introduction to the Web of Things

runs.text: The W3C Web of Things (WoT) describes a device or a service by a Thing Description: a JSON-LD document that names its properties, actions and events and states which protocol operation reads, writes, observes or invokes each of them. A Thing Model is the reusable, instance-independent template a Thing Description is derived from. Which protocol an affordance actually speaks is supplied by a binding: a vocabulary that maps the abstract operations onto one concrete protocol.

This document is that binding for OPC UA. It defines the JSON-LD vocabulary bound to the prefix uav, with which a Thing Description addresses OPC UA Nodes, expresses the Read, Write, Observe and Call operations as OPC UA Services, and carries the parts of an address space — NodeClasses, Attributes, References and modelling rules — that a Thing Description otherwise has no way to say.

Because the vocabulary covers the address space and not only the protocol, it is also a conversion format: a NodeSet2 file can be expressed as a Thing Model or Thing Description and recovered from it, with the exceptional cases that a semantic mapping cannot reach carried in an explicit, verifiable envelope.

runs.text: The namespace metadata provide standardized information about the elements of this namespace, which an aggregating Server relies on. All Nodes defined by this document are static: they are identical in every Server, including the Value Attribute.

The information is provided as an Object of type NamespaceMetadataType, a component of the Namespaces Object of the Server Object. The NamespaceMetadataType ObjectType and its Properties are defined in OPC 10000-5. The same version information is carried by the ModelTableEntry of the UANodeSet XML file.
The IsNamespaceSubset Property is False because the UANodeSet XML file contains the complete namespace. A Server exposing only a subset sets it to True.

Namespaces are used by OPC UA to create unique identifiers across different naming authorities. The NodeId and BrowseName Attributes are identifiers. A Node in the AddressSpace is unambiguously identified by its NodeId; a BrowseName is not unique and is used to build a browse path or to name a standard Property.
